scope: Current, explicitly reviewed complete quotations bound to exact raw or edited streams. Each case/section/quotation occurs once; source-specific verifiers cover additional displays. This is a quotation count, not a physical-source or decipherment count.
limits: Only individually declared separator occurrences, bracketed expansions and question punctuation may be omitted or added. Literal numerical labels, unresolved positions and retained separator labels stay in order.

Local frame and reading captions are bound to the exact stream. Earlier authors retain their attribution in the case. A displayed proposal remains conditional where its source or reconstruction requires that qualification.
This mapping checks display correspondence. Source authenticity, repair costs, square-cell coupling and historical interpretation remain with the linked source certificates.
